keyboard_observations: Minimum 200%: Up selected Beta. Enter initially focused loading read-only MED-02; settled UIA exposed SYNTH-001 / MED-02 and Demo active B. Ctrl+A selected the matching complete read-only text. Escape returned to the medication table; native Down selected Gamma, independently establishing table return.

Minimum 200%: Tab reached View selected Active Medications item detail; Enter loaded MED-03 / Demo active C / Zoë 李. Escape returned to its table. Ctrl+O focused patient search; Escape preserved SYNTH-001 and returned to Select new synthetic patient, with Cover Sheet selections/detail cleared.

Minimum 100%: native horizontal scrolling moved medication content and exposed the trailing Status column. Reverse Tab from medications reached the retained Vitals View action and revealed the full-width Vitals row. Reverse Tab reveal was also sampled at minimum 150% and both 125% samples.

Default 100%: native Tab from the toolbar reached Problem List, Allergies, Vitals, its retained View action and Active Medications in sequence. Space focused matching MED-03 text with Demo active C and Unicode. Native double-click Alpha focused matching MED-01 / Demo active A. Escape left Alpha selected in the medication table with detail closed for user listening.
uia_limits: Immediate snapshots can retain a prior selected label or loading text; settled observations were checked separately.
Fluent table public has-focus does not reflect its internal keyboard scope; native input/UIA are distinct from callback/focus probes.

Related 16x16 surfaces were excluded from full-window geometry; coordinate input used the actual full screenshot ID. One scroll call without that ID was rejected as outside the 16x16 surface; it was reobserved and corrected.

limits: Normal-timer review harness first establishes fixture state; all described native actions occur after its completion.
